In an experiment, two of the halogens are represented as P and Q .
2 2
P combines with hydrogen on heating to form HP, which can be easily broken down into its
elements. A solution of HP in water reacts with aqueous silver ions to form a yellow precipitate
that is insoluble in dilute aqueous ammonia.

solution of HQ in water reacts with aqueous silver ions to form a white precipitate that is soluble
in dilute aqueous ammonia.
